title: gzkit ADR Schema
description: Schema for Architecture Decision Records - frontmatter and required headers.

id.description: ADR identifier. Non-pool ADRs require a slug suffix (e.g., ADR-0.1.0-feature-name); pool ADRs use ADR-pool.<slug>. The slug is mandatory on non-pool ADRs to prevent bare-semver drift between frontmatter and the canonical on-disk directory name (GHI #346).

kind.description: ADR taxonomy: foundation ADRs carry semver 0.0.x and govern infrastructure; feature ADRs carry any other semver and deliver end-user capability. Pool ADRs have no kind in frontmatter — kind is derived from the ADR-pool.* id prefix.

sensitivity.description: Security sensitivity classification (ADR-0.0.22). Optional; absent means no security gate. Auto-detect floor and validate scope land in OBPI-0.0.22-03.
